title: Pear diamond ring, 18K gold
subtitle: The pear shape is the only brilliant cut with a directional axis — the pointed tip establishes an orientation the eye follows. The elongated point draws the eye along the finger while the surrounding stones frame the center without competing with it. The setting was designed to hold the pear's point in the right position against the hand.
